Definition: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) to turn; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to turn toward or from or away; 1a2) to turn and do; 1a3) to turn, decline (of day); 1a4) to turn toward, approach (of evening); 1a5) to turn and look, look, look back or at or after or for; 1b) (Piel) to turn away, put out of the way, make clear, clear away; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to turn; 1c2) to make a turn, show signs of turning, turn back; 1d) (Hophal) to be turned back
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
